properties.name: Emirate of Córdoba
properties.linkNote: The Codex has no article for the Emirate of Córdoba (756–929). This links to al-Andalus, the region. The Caliphate of Córdoba is a later state (929–1031) and is deliberately NOT linked here.

properties.name: West Francia
properties.gapNote: No article. The Codex covers the Carolingian Empire it was partitioned from, and the Kingdom of France it became.

properties.name: Emirate of Sicily
properties.gapNote: No article for Muslim Sicily. The Codex's Kingdom of Sicily is the later Norman state, from 1130, and is deliberately not linked here.

properties.name: Bulgars
properties.gapNote: Old Great Bulgaria, which is not the First Bulgarian Empire the Codex covers. Deliberately unlinked.

properties.name: Serbia
properties.gapNote: Deliberately unlinked. The Codex's Serbia article is the polity of 1371–1459; the Serbia on these maps is the earlier principality, which is a different state and has no article.

properties.name: East Francia
properties.gapNote: No article. The Codex covers the Carolingian Empire it was partitioned from, and the Holy Roman Empire it became.

properties.name: Khazars
properties.gapNote: No article for the Khazar Khaganate.
